observed_structure: The enclosing GEMMKernel aliases two transpose-aware BlockLoader types and one BlockMMA type parameterized by tile dimensions, accumulator type, and epilogue.
gemm_loop receives separate threadgroup operand tiles, the two loader objects, the BlockMMA object, the full K-tile iteration count, edge-tile dimensions, and the remaining-K extent from its caller.

Each full K-tile iteration executes a threadgroup-memory barrier, selects the aligned or edge-aware load for each operand, executes a second threadgroup-memory barrier, calls mma on the staged tiles, and advances both loaders.

When K is not aligned, a separate terminal path computes transpose-aware remaining tile dimensions, safely loads both operands between the same two barriers, and performs one final mma without advancing the loaders.
variant_notes: Compile-time M, N, and K alignment flags and transpose parameters determine loader shapes and safe-versus-unsafe load calls; these choices are not normalized into the common recurrence.
The cited helper includes a separate K-remainder path but does not own the result store; output layout, epilogue application, and publication remain caller behavior.
BlockLoader safe and unsafe method names are recorded as source branch choices and do not prove bounds, zero-fill, synchronization, or memory safety.
